title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Jonathan Wroblewski has been the Director of the Harvard Law School Semester in Washington Program since 2010. From 2008 until 2024, he served as the Director of the Office of Policy and Legislation in the Criminal Division of the U.S. Department of Justice. In that capacity, he led a team of policy analysts and attorneys […]
